svg.aria-label: To down: After 2 down results in a row, from any status. Back up: From down to ok or degraded after 3 results in a row that are not down. Degraded: From ok to degraded at once. Back to ok after 2 ok results in a row. First: From unknown to ok or degraded after 1 result that is not down. Restart: No event again: pulse writes an event only when the stored status differs
